prompt: Which condition is true only when `x` is from 1 to 10, including both ends?
explain: Both parts must hold, so use `&&`. With `||` every number passes. `1 <= x <= 10` looks right but C works it out left to right: `1 <= x` gives 0 or 1, and that is always at most 10. And `>` and `<` leave out 1 and 10.
